title: Triathlon: Hermosa, Caluya top NAGT Camotes in style

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— Southeast Asian Games gold medalist Matthew Justine Hermosa and triathlon prospect Anisha Eunice Caluya made easy work in their elite division races in the National Age Group Triathlon (NAGT) Camotes on Sunday, October 25, at the Santiago Bay White Sand Beach in San Francisco in Camotes Island. Hermosa, the pride of Talisay City, clocked in 58 minutes and 59 seconds for his first NAGT win for the year. He has been raring to race again after missing the recent Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan.
